print_hint_visibility.text:
仅选择交换校准时展开

B面顺时针转四分之一圈：河边在上、大场地在左、体育中心在右。相机侧和用途仍需自行判断。

免费提示 1

三张卡来自同一段连续视野。先区分远处目标、前面的交通牌和馆楼边缘。

免费提示 2

把远塔那张放在起端，馆楼／屋顶边缘放在另一端；交通牌卡接在中间。牌后的缺口是遮挡。

免费提示 3

远塔→交通牌→馆楼／屋顶；选择保留前景遮挡。纸版将对应三条河景按此顺序接成一幅，不补写被挡文字。

免费提示 1

只让主河竖直还不够；镜像图也能做到。再看支流从哪一岸进入、柳桥跨的是哪条河。

免费提示 2

把指北针恢复向上，并让主支河、两国桥与柳桥同时符合对照图。舞台题签不必改成实地地名。

免费提示 3

标准朝向、非镜像；舞台称稲瀬川，真实借景是隅田川。纸图从反面改到正面后再旋转，直到三锚点同时对上。

免费提示 1

雕像纪念的人生活得很早，不代表含这座现代庭园的画面也一样早。分别查两条时间线。

免费提示 2

1680属于芭蕉迁居；1995属于此展望庭园开园。1981是本馆开馆，并非这处庭园的年份。

免费提示 3

选1680、1995、1995或以后。只排除这张参照是1930原始摄影；不判定具体年份、作者或实时位置。

免费提示 1

河边、大场地和体育中心一起校准；只对河边可能仍是镜像。史料中的1929不能替你旋转今天的图。

免费提示 2

标准示意把河边画在上方，大场地在左、体育中心在右；游乐区在体育中心的另一侧。近景先遇到什么，就从那一侧看。

免费提示 3

标准朝向、非镜像；选游乐区侧、体育中心、CAPTURE AT取景定位。保留前景，不把体育中心当剧院或收件地点。

免费提示 1

先看哪四条是名称，哪一条是位置事件。别把一次迁址变成另一个剧院名。

免费提示 2

喜昇早于久松，千歳在明治之前。两国桥的西两国戏棚是这条沿革的前身。

免费提示 3

喜昇座1873→久松座1879→千歳座1885→明治座1893；1928放迁址／再开场。今日对应明治座，实际回执交游戏主办方。

print_hint_visibility.text:
Open only if you selected shared calibration

Turn Face B a quarter-turn clockwise: river edge above, field left, sports centre right. You still determine camera side and purpose.

Free hint 1

The cards belong to one continuous view. Distinguish the distant landmark, the nearer traffic sign and the museum building edge.

Free hint 2

Put the distant-tower card at the start and the building/roof edge at the other end. The traffic-sign card joins them. The gap behind the sign is an overlap.

Free hint 3

Tower → sign → building/roof. Keep the foreground overlap. Join the matching river strips in that order without inventing obscured text.

Free hint 1

A vertical main river is not enough: a mirror image can do that too. Check which bank the tributary enters from and which river Yanagi Bridge crosses.

Free hint 2

Restore north to the top and match the main river, tributary and both bridges together. The stage caption does not have to become the real place name.

Free hint 3

Use the canonical orientation, without mirroring. Stage: Inase. Real scenery: Sumida. On paper, change to the correct face and rotate until all three anchors match.

Free hint 1

An old historical figure does not make a view containing this modern garden equally old. Check the two timelines separately.

Free hint 2

1680 belongs to Basho’s move. 1995 belongs to this observation garden. 1981 is the main museum’s opening, not this garden’s.

Free hint 3

Choose 1680, 1995, and “1995 or later”. This rules out the reference being a 1930 original photograph; it does not identify its exact year, maker or a live location.

Free hint 1

Match river edge, field and sports centre together. Matching only the river may leave a mirror image. The historical date 1929 cannot orient today’s map for you.

Free hint 2

In the canonical diagram the river edge is above, the field left and the sports centre right, with the playground beyond it. The foreground tells you which side the observer is on.

Free hint 3

Use the canonical orientation without mirroring. Select playground side, sports centre and CAPTURE AT. Keep the foreground; the sports centre is neither the theatre nor a delivery destination.

Free hint 1

Separate the four names from the event about location. A move does not create another theatre name.

Free hint 2

Kisho comes before Hisamatsu; Chitose before Meiji. The west-Ryogoku playhouses are the predecessor in this history.

Free hint 3

Kisho-za 1873 → Hisamatsu-za 1879 → Chitose-za 1885 → Meiji-za 1893. Put 1928 under relocation/reopening. The present counterpart is Meijiza; the game host receives your actual receipt.
